summary: BTC in late-cycle markdown with fair valuations, distribution flows, and bearish momentum, while global liquidity expands — a clash between a supportive macro backdrop and an exhausted cycle.
regime_read: The composite risk regime is DISTRIBUTE / froth, with the cycle deep into markdown (72% through), 797 days since halving, and momentum firmly bearish (structure broken, ER 0.61). Valuations are fair – MVRV-Z 0.21 (16th percentile), NUPL 0.11, Mayer Multiple 0.78 – not cheap enough to signal a floor. Leverage is elevated (OI 74th percentile) but funding is flat (z 0.15) and basis is steady, creating a fragile equilibrium where any bearish catalyst could trigger long-liquidations. Options show calm vol (DVOL 47.6, sweet-spot) and a bullish put/call OI skew (0.57), but the term slope is negative, hinting at near-term apprehension. On-chain demand is weak: ETF flows are in distribution (z -0.91), Coinbase premium deeply negative, stablecoin growth contracting (z -1.76), and miners are in capitulation (hash ribbon). This is a late-cycle distribution environment where the asset struggles to absorb selling even as macro liquidity expands.
conflicts: Global M2 expanding (+7.4% y/y) and net liquidity rising vs. BTC bearish momentum and distribution regime — the liquidity tailwind is being rejected, suggesting late-cycle exhaustion and high real yields (2.23%) are capping any bid.

Valuation appears fair (MVRV-Z 0.21, NUPL 0.11) but OI is high (74th percentile) and ETF flows are distributing — positioning is heavy relative to the spot bid, raising the risk of a leverage flush if momentum stays negative.
Options put/call OI ratio is bullish (0.57) while spot momentum is bearish — this divergence can resolve with a short-squeeze or with capitulation as call overwriters get run over.
rotation_check: The working liquidity thesis partially holds: global M2 and net liquidity are expanding, which historically coincides with BTC rallies. However, reality diverges sharply — BTC is in a markdown phase, with bearish structure and persistent ETF outflows, despite the liquidity tailwind. The thesis needs an added filter: late-cycle positioning (797 days post-halving) and elevated real yields (2.23%) override the liquidity signal. Also, the domestic stablecoin contraction and negative Coinbase premium show the liquidity is not trickling into on-chain demand. In the past, such divergence (expanding global liquidity + declining BTC) has marked late stages of the cycle when the asset is de-leveraging before the next accumulation phase.
transmission: 10Y real yield falling below 2.0% could re-rate the long-duration narrative and attract ETF inflows even late-cycle.
A turn higher in stablecoin growth (currently contracting) would indicate fresh dry powder entering the ecosystem.
OI declining below the 50th percentile while funding stays neutral would signal a healthier reset before any sustainable bounce.
Credit spreads (HY OAS) widening above 3.0–3.5% would trigger a risk-off gate, making the liquidity expansion irrelevant for risk assets.
DXY breaking below 100 would ease financial conditions and could revive the Coinbase premium.
watch_items: MVRV-Z moving into undervaluation (<0.10) while global liquidity remains expanding — historically a powerful set-up for accumulation.
ETF flow turning positive (z > 0) after an extended distribution streak — signals demand returning.
Real 10-year yield starting a sustained decline below 2.0% — removes the restrictive discount rate headwind.
OI price divergence turning negative — confirmation of a leverage unwind that could flush weak hands.
Coinbase premium flipping positive — indicates US-based spot demand returning.

zh.summary: 比特币处于周期末段的回撤阶段，估值合理，存在派发流量和看跌动能，而全球流动性在扩张——这是支撑性宏观背景与枯竭周期之间的冲突。
zh.regime_read: 综合风险状态为派发/泡沫，周期深度进入回撤阶段（已进行72%），距离减半797天，动能坚定看跌（结构已破，ER 0.61）。估值合理——MVRV-Z 0.21（第16百分位），NUPL 0.11，Mayer Multiple 0.78——但未便宜到足以预示底部。杠杆率较高（OI第74百分位），但资金费率持平（z 0.15），基差稳定，形成脆弱的平衡，任何看跌催化剂都可能触发多头清算。期权显示波动率平静（DVOL 47.6，最佳区间），且看跌/看涨持仓量偏度看涨（0.57），但期限斜率为负，暗示近期担忧。链上需求疲弱：ETF流量处于派发（z -0.91），Coinbase溢价深度为负，稳定币增长收缩（z -1.76），矿工处于投降状态（算力带）。这是周期末段的派发环境，即使宏观流动性扩张，资产也难以吸收卖压。
zh.rotation_check: 有效的流动性理论部分成立：全球M2和净流动性在扩张，历史上这通常与比特币上涨一致。然而，现实严重背离——尽管有流动性顺风，比特币仍处于回撤阶段，结构看跌且ETF持续流出。该理论需要增加一个过滤器：周期末段定位（减产后797天）和较高的实际收益率（2.23%）压倒了流动性信号。此外，国内稳定币收缩和负面的Coinbase溢价表明流动性并未渗透到链上需求。过去，这种背离（全球流动性扩张+比特币下跌）标志着周期后期，资产正在去杠杆，为下一个累积阶段做准备。
conflicts: 全球M2扩张（同比增长7.4%）且净流动性上升，而比特币呈现看跌动能和派发状态——流动性顺风被拒绝，表明周期末段耗尽和高实际收益率（2.23%）限制了任何买盘。
估值看似合理（MVRV-Z 0.21，NUPL 0.11），但OI高（第74百分位）且ETF流量在派发——相对于现货买盘，仓位过重，若动能持续为负，则增加了杠杆清算的风险。
期权看跌/看涨持仓量比率看涨（0.57），而现货动能看跌——这种背离可以通过轧空或由于看涨期权卖方面临压力而投降来解决。
transmission: 10年期实际收益率跌破2.0%可能重新定义久期叙事，并在周期后期吸引ETF资金流入。
稳定币增长（目前处于收缩）的回升将意味着新资金进入生态系统。
未平仓合约跌至50百分位以下，同时资金费率保持中性，将预示着在可持续反弹前出现更健康的调整。
信用利差（高收益OAS）扩大至3.0–3.5%以上将触发避险模式，使流动性扩张对风险资产失去意义。
美元指数跌破100将缓解金融状况，并可能重振Coinbase溢价。
watch_items: MVRV-Z进入低估区间（<0.10），同时全球流动性持续扩张——历史上这是一个强劲的累积买入信号。
ETF流量转为正值（z > 0），经过一段长时间的分发后——表明需求回归。
实际10年期收益率开始持续下跌至2.0%以下——消除了限制性贴现率逆风。
OI价格背离转为负值——确认杠杆平仓可能洗出弱势持仓。
Coinbase溢价转正——表明美国现货需求回归。
